facts.fact: The product is a rear lamp, an exterior lighting and signalling module combining several light functions, a lens and a retro-reflector in one housing.
facts.evidence: Spec 'Product Type': 'Rear lamp — exterior lighting & signalling module combining multiple light functions, lens, and retro-reflector in a single housing.'

facts.fact: The vehicle category is M1 passenger car.
The lamp provides rear position signalling.
facts.evidence: Spec 'Function': 'Rear position signalling (presence/visibility)'; 'Main Parts': Rear position lamp

facts.fact: The lamp provides a braking indication (stop lamp function).
facts.evidence: Spec 'Function': 'Braking indication (stop lamp)'; 'Main Parts': Stop lamp

facts.fact: The lamp includes a passive retro-reflector.
facts.evidence: Spec 'Function': 'Passive conspicuity (retro-reflector)'; 'Main Parts': Retro-reflector; the image shows a ribbed rectangular panel at the lower right of the lens view.

facts.fact: The outer lens defines light transmission and colour and is made of red-tinted, UV-stabilised PMMA.
facts.evidence: Spec 'Function': 'Light transmission & color definition (outer lens)'; Materials table: 'Outer lens — PMMA (red-tinted, UV-stabilised)'

facts.fact: The light source is LED modules on a PCB.
facts.evidence: Materials table: 'Light source — LED modules on PCB'; the image shows three rows of 8 LED reflector cups plus a row of small round apertures.

facts.fact: The housing, reflector surface, seal and fasteners are made of the listed typical materials, which are representative and not confirmed.
facts.evidence: Materials table: housing PP or ASA/PC; reflector surface PC with vacuum-metallised aluminium; seal TPE or silicone; fasteners PA, POM or steel. The spec states 'Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.'

facts.fact: The retro-reflector is made of PMMA with molded prism optics.
The image shows a single combined housing with an exposed optical interior view and a closed outer-lens view, with a separate lower-right cavity that appears to hold a reflector or reversing optic.
facts.evidence: Image: the top view shows an LED array, a central rectangular recess and a lower-right cavity with a gridded optic; the bottom view shows the outer lens covering the housing with a ribbed rectangular panel.

facts.fact: The spec says UNECE lighting regulations apply across M and N categories.
facts.evidence: Spec 'Vehicle Category': 'UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.'
